do you ever clean nature from trash? if so, this is for you:

Message from @luminaenvision  from Greenpill Phangan:
My news for today are: I successfully created a pool on gardens.fund 

Whoever joined our gardens, please activate governance, you will need it to vote on proposals. Whoever feels to add more funds - of course you are welcome to do so as well 😇 we are working with cUSD, right now I have 700 cUSD in the pool thanks to Ethereum for the World 

https://app.gardens.fund/gardens/42220/0x6068dfc4f2aeca09d8d5845896f3aa76d0fe6960/0x86b5da0cd4c9ec00145bc763e44d12ad9ffb2cbb

You are welcome to create proposal for your cleanup as well, but the first step is to actually submit it on dapp.decleanup.net, not skipping the impact report form (generally it’s optional), but you are allowed to skip submitting recycables step.  thoughts from me and curated links:
I am disappointed, heartbroken, frustrated that Artizen is coming to an unexpected end and as of now won’t fulfill the promises made. I am deeply sorry I encouraged utilizing of it. I am still trying to wrap my head around what is happening.

If you had a project on Artizen, please take some time rather sooner than later to read through the links shared below 

do read the fine print before signing anything.
 please do consider your options:
if you would like to go the safest (in my opinion) route with the highest likelihood in my opinion it is very much worth considering rquesting the payout before November 30th:
Go to artizen.fund and fill out the payment  form until end of November to get the money of the artifacts you sold if you had a project on the platform. The downside of  requesting the payout this way is that you wave your rights to claim more payouts e.g. of match funding & cash prizes projects were promised & expecting. My personal opinion is that the most likely way to get some money out is to hand in the payment request instead of speculating of a potentially successful lawsuit that may result in a higher payout. I could be wrong with this assessment. This is not legal or financial advice. Please do feel free to consider seeking professional legal or financial advice to make your decision. I am sharing my intuition and personal opinion here based on my instincts that have been meaningfully wrong in the last.

prices include tokens from:
-  nounspace.com - interface for social media starting with being a farcaster client - will also be possible to use it to access different social media ‚silos‘ all in one

We’re bringing back Let’s GROW Live with a new format to amplify voices of regen movement across the globe. We are organising a 24h Livestream on Monthly Earthday (EarthStream) i.e. 22nd July as a pilot. 
We're inviting hosts and stewards to co create this event. As you know, it’s a lot of fun to connect with fellow regens from around the world and hear their stories!

It's a blend of festival/symposium/retreat happening August 27-31, near Prague. What makes it special is that it brings together ALL sectors of the regenerative movement - from tech and finance to ecology, art, and beyond.
If you're looking to connect with fellow regens in a natural setting, form deeper relationships beyond the usual conference networking, and co-create solutions together, this could be perfect for you.
The whole thing is co-created - everyone contributes workshops, talks, or activities. It's like having the best conversations from X/Discord,etc but in person, in nature, over 5 days.
 Would love to see some of you there!

The 30 creator projects in tis epoch are telling stories of Ethereum in ways much closer to the original crypto ethos and more intune with the existing web3 world than most crypto stories in the media. 26 hours left to allocate your rewards in Octant epoch 9 if you already have $glm locked; if you do; please go to octant.app/projects and select a few projects / creators you appreciate. More people know about this epoch than about any previous one so let’s make sure it is a fair one with more allocators than right now. 
Currently, epoch 9 has about half the number of participating donors/allocators of epoch 7 (the climate epoch). Let’s allocate those rewards and lead to many more ETH received by the people telling the story of Ethereum in ways that change the perception of ‚crypto‘.

All projects in the epoch are great. In my personal opinion, fork’d by Natalie Crue (https://octant.app/project/9/0xca85460d23Bfb2e0079bAb5AAC84921D9D0762a4) is one that definitely deserves more donors. Natalie has been showing up in the DAO world for years as a strong voice for fairness and advocating for using crypto for good in the real world: Through clubhouse rooms on humanitarian web3 projects, long hours of helping people to make sense of the blockchain world in nfts.tips rooms - always keeping the original grassroots ethos of crypto alive and speaking up when things in web3 drift away from the ethos of a fairer world, no-BS - with her deep experience in activism and the art world she is a shining example of how crypto enables true advocacy, accessibility and change real lives in the real world and how that culture can be stewarded online.

live now (3pmUTC): weekly nouncil discord: https://discord.gg/3p9PuZfa 
Now is the time to activate if you’ve ever cared about nouns DAO in my humble opinion - prop 923 (https://www.nouns.camp/proposals/923)  proposes to set the minimum bid of daily nouns auctions at 3ETH - it has always been 0 since the beginning of nouns DAO over 4 years ago - only allowing people to buy new nouns with by paying at least 3 ETH makes the DAO unnecessarily inaccessible and would also likely lead to many days without a noun sold which has never happened so far - feel free to join the nouncil call that’s starting in a few minutes to hear more about it and/or signal / comment onchain here - you do not need to hold a noun to signal or comment - if you don’t hold a noun it’s just with 0 votes but it will very much show sentiment which may be critical. Now is also the time to reach out to nouns holders you know to let them know this is happening - and it’s worth voting against in my personal opinion - if all small holders of nouns vote against this proposal, it can be stopped. If not, it is likely that the ‚break even movement’ voting block of whales will push this prop with through with justification of book value (BV) and further captures more of if THE truest DAO ecosystems  https://www.nouns.camp/proposals/923
